'''Sticrie''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire.]] Although Moff Sticrie was ostensibly in charge of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]], the native [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor's]] commitment to justice led them to refuse offer him the customary bribes, privileges, and diplomatic immunity for Imperial officials he received elsewhere. As a result, he preferred to govern the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] from [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]] and avoided Kel Dor politics unless there were any interruptions in tax collection.
